workspace/deliverable/revenue_memo.md:19:**Criterion.** Bill-and-hold control transfer requires a substantive reason, separately identified customer goods, goods ready for physical transfer, and no ability for the seller to use or redirect them; **all** criteria must be met. A return right also makes consideration variable, with revenue limited to the amount not expected to be refunded and a refund liability ([ASC 606 bill-and-hold and rights of return](../library/asc606_contract_and_bill_hold.md)).
workspace/deliverable/revenue_memo.md:27:**Criterion.** An identified asset with no substantive supplier substitution right, substantially all economic benefits, and customer direction of how and for what purpose it is used is an embedded lease.
